title: AnythingLLM v1.18.0
body_markdown:
## What's Changed


- fix: point k8s probes at the server's /api/ping by[@u00dxk2](https://github.com/u00dxk2) in[#6592](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6592)
- fix: don't crash when removing a parsed file while an image is attached by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6585](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6585)
- fix: open the clicked image when attachments share a file name by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6586](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6586)
- fix: stop sending history attachments to providers that build prompts from raw chat history by[@simonether](https://github.com/simonether) in[#6591](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6591)
- fix: compare embed allowlist entries as browser origins by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6584](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6584)
- add dismissal comment to prevent low-effort research claims by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6608](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6608)
- fix: send agent tool required params on every provider path by[@wenqiw777](https://github.com/wenqiw777) in[#6595](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6595)
- fix: honor the SDK retry count when ANYTHINGLLM_MAX_RETRIES is set by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6597](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6597)
- fix: save the Outlook account type so sign-in uses the right tenant by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6599](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6599)
- fix: show an error when a system prompt variable change fails by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6604](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6604)
- fix: apply TOOL_CALL_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS to Telegram tool approvals by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6601](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6601)
- fix: convert the hourly schedule minute to UTC in half-hour time zones by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6605](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6605)
- fix: select entire folder after upload when picker is paginated by[@YokoAC](https://github.com/YokoAC) in[#6610](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6610)
- fix: keep numeric strings over 15 digits as text in created Excel files by[@deepanshupal](https://github.com/deepanshupal) in[#6613](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6613)
- fix: restore dropped i18n placeholders in MCP and profile strings by[@theluckystrike](https://github.com/theluckystrike) in[#6614](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6614)
- fix: scrape each page once when bulk links differ only by #fragment by[@MohammadHijjawi97](https://github.com/MohammadHijjawi97) in[#6619](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6619)
- fix: attach requested files to Outlook replies and reply drafts by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6623](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6623)
- fix: return 404 for an unknown workspace on manage-users and update-pin by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6625](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6625)
- fix: load the next page of documents from the server's offset in the picker by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6628](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6628)
- fix: show an error when embedding attached files into the workspace fails by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6629](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6629)
- fix: restore dropped i18n values in model router and model picker strings by[@theluckystrike](https://github.com/theluckystrike) in[#6631](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6631)
- fix: preserve referenced MBOX chat attachments during orphan cleanup by[@dakjdakd](https://github.com/dakjdakd) in[#6633](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6633)
- fix: isolate chat attachment state and uploads by conversation by[@dakjdakd](https://github.com/dakjdakd) in[#6635](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6635)
- fix: finalize stopped scheduled job runs on Windows by[@dakjdakd](https://github.com/dakjdakd) in[#6637](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6637)
- fix: don't treat YouTube channel URLs as video links in the collector by[@theluckystrike](https://github.com/theluckystrike) in[#6644](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6644)
- fix: apply workspace similarity threshold to agent rag-memory search by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6648](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6648)
- fix: write bulk scraped pages that share a file name to separate files by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6650](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6650)
- fix: surface Confluence load failures instead of reporting no pages by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6652](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6652)
- fix: restore document embedding for AstraDB by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6654](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6654)
- fix: stop scheduled jobs after switching to multi-user mode by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6656](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6656)
- fix(server): keep $$ and $& intact when expanding prompt variables by[@rome-xi](https://github.com/rome-xi) in[#6676](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6676)
- fix(collector): stop treating binary types with no converter as text by[@moneebullah25](https://github.com/moneebullah25) in[#6670](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6670)
- fix: use response.send instead of response.text in repo provider check by[@Saadanjum0](https://github.com/Saadanjum0) in[#6677](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6677)
- fix: use a realistic fallback divisor for collector token estimates by[@moneebullah25](https://github.com/moneebullah25) in[#6672](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6672)
- fix: return after resolve in wipeCollectorStorage guards by[@moneebullah25](https://github.com/moneebullah25) in[#6671](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6671)
- Fix raw think blocks in scheduled job responses after tool calls by[@shatfield4](https://github.com/shatfield4) in[#6663](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6663)
- fix: keep unsent prompt text when attaching a file creates a new thread by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6704](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6704)
- fix: retry watched documents when re-embedding fails by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6701](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6701)
- fix: report a failed first Paperless-ngx request instead of no documents found by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6699](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6699)
- fix: keep the configured Paperless-ngx URL when following page links by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6698](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6698)
- fix: pass transcription and OCR settings to linked files by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6697](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6697)
- fix: give the same login error for an unknown username and a wrong password by @marmar9615-cloud in[#6693](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6693)
- fix: render nested and repeated lists correctly in created Word documents by[@wenqiw777](https://github.com/wenqiw777) in[#6688](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6688)
- fix: request serial tool use for Anthropic agent providers by[@dakjdakd](https://github.com/dakjdakd) in[#6708](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6708)
- fix: propagate PGVector transaction failures without losing the original error by[@dakjdakd](https://github.com/dakjdakd) in[#6706](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6706)
- fix: cancel queued scheduled-job runs when a job is disabled or resynced by[@dakjdakd](https://github.com/dakjdakd) in[#6710](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6710)
- v1.18.0 tags by[@timothycarambat](https://github.com/timothycarambat) in[#6711](https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm/pull/6711)
